Russian birth tourism to Brazil is increasing, according to DW.com.
The trend involves Russian women traveling to Brazil to give birth.
DW.com reports the increase as a notable development.
Brazil has become a destination for this practice among Russian families.
The report comes from DW.com.
Source: DW.com
